elevator_pitch: A compact 2-layer PCB that pairs an Arduino Nano with the E01-ML01DP5 transceiver module to deliver reliable 2.5 km-range RC telemetry — designed for long-range UAV and model rocketry applications.
description:
• E01-ML01DP5 (nRF24L01+ PA+LNA, 25 dBm) achieves 2.5 km open-terrain range — 5× further than typical off-the-shelf RC receivers.

• Dedicated AMS1117 3.3 V LDO with 100 nF + 10 µF decoupling to isolate the transceiver during TX bursts.

• Selectable address jumpers support simultaneous multi-receiver operation (mesh networking); through-hole construction allows field repair without a hot-air station.
